entities.name: Paging procedure
entities.description: Used by the network to request establishment or resumption of a NAS signalling connection to the UE. Also used to prompt UE reattachment after network failure and to initiate mobile terminating CS fallback, SMS, or user data transfer via MME.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that receives paging messages from the network.

entities.name: UE not attached condition
entities.description: Condition where UE is not attached to the network when it receives paging for EPS services.

entities.name: Ignore paging behavior
entities.description: UE behavior where it ignores paging messages when not attached for EPS services.

entities.name: Mobile terminating CS fallback initiation
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network via paging to handle circuit-switched fallback for mobile terminating calls.

entities.name: SMS transfer initiation
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network via paging to handle SMS transfer.

entities.name: User data transfer initiation
entities.description: Procedure initiated by network via paging to handle user data transfer via MME.

relations.description: Paging procedure is triggered by network action targeting the UE.
When UE is not attached condition is met, it establishes ignore paging behavior.
Paging procedure can include initiation of mobile terminating CS fallback.
Paging procedure can include initiation of SMS transfer.
Paging procedure can include initiation of user data transfer via MME.
